faqs.q: Sec. 18-504. - I.P.M.C. Section 304.11, Chimneys and towers.
faqs.a:
Section 304.11. Chimneys and towers,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
304.11. Chimneys and towers.
All chimneys, cooling towers, smoke stacks, and similar appurtenances shall be maintained
                  structurally safe and sound. All exposed surfaces of metal or wood shall be protected
                  from the elements and against decay or rust."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
